members.name: format
members.what: Says that this file is a list's configuration, and of which version

members.name: details
members.what: The list's own values: its notes and its section

members.name: item fields
members.what: The fields every item of the list has, in the order they are shown

members.name: actions
members.what: What can be done with an item of the list, by a key or from the menu

members.name: Notes
members.what: Notes about the list

members.name: Section
members.what: The section of the top level the list stands in

field.what: A field of the list's items

members.name: title
members.what: The field's name, as it is shown and said

members.name: type
members.what: What the field holds

members.name: value
members.what: The value a new item starts with

members.name: options
members.what: The values to choose from, for the type choice

members.name: name
members.what: The action's name, as the menu shows it

members.name: key
members.what: The key that runs it; without one it runs from the menu

members.name: does
members.what: What the action does

members.name: fields
members.what: A form that asks for values before the action runs

members.name: set
members.what: For does set: the fields it writes, each with its value

members.name: to
members.what: For does move: the list the item moves to, as a path from this list

members.name: open
members.what: For does open: a field that holds a web address, or an app such as json

members.name: program
members.what: For does run: the program, by its name or its full path

members.name: arguments
members.what: For does run: the program's arguments, each one text

members.name: input
members.what: For does run: a text the program reads as its input

members.name: command
members.what: For does terminal: the command for axTerminal's field, the program first, each part one text

members.name: folder
members.what: For does run and terminal: where it runs: list, the list's folder, or a path

members.name: seconds
members.what: For does run: how long the program may take, 1 to 600

members.name: then
members.what: For does run: what happens when the program ends without an error

form field.what: A field of an action's form

members.name: title
members.what: The field's name, written as an instruction: it is what is read as the box's name

members.name: type
members.what: The kind of box

members.name: value
members.what: What the box starts with

members.name: options
members.what: The values to choose from, for the type choice

members.name: required
members.what: Whether the action waits until the field holds something

members.name: hidden
members.what: Whether the field is typed unseen; such a field may fill the input alone

then.what: What follows a program that ended without an error

members.name: set
members.what: The fields it writes, each with its value
